visual_description: White marble tower ~45m. Tall rectangular top block with turquoise tile panel, on a wide inverted-Y/Y-shaped base: a huge pointed (ogive) central arch flanked by two sloping faceted wings, the whole base a wide trapezoid with fine vertical ribbing. Turquoise tilework in the arch soffit. Sits on a plaza with a reflecting pool.

landmark_en: El Goli pavilion in its lake, Tabriz
visual_description: Two-storey octagonal pavilion (brick, ochre/cream) with a pointed pyramidal roof and arched windows, standing on an island in the centre of a large square artificial lake, linked by a causeway; low trees on the shore, lake reflection.

Long low brick/stone bridge with 33 pointed arches in two tiers: an upper arcade of arched openings along the full length, lower row of pier arches over the river; wider pavilion bulges at both ends; ochre sandstone and brick. About 295m long, very elongated horizontal composition.
note: Missing from your new list; kept as Si-o-se-pol (reference subject).

visual_description: Terrace platform of grey-gold limestone on the foot of a mountain; Gate of All Nations with winged bull guardians, a grand double stair, and rows of slender fluted columns (some with bull-head capitals) of the Apadana, many broken.

landmark_fa: گنبد طلایی حرم امام رضا، مشهد
landmark_en: Golden dome of Imam Reza Shrine, Mashhad
visual_description: Large gold-plated bulbous dome on a tall drum, flanked by gold-topped minarets and a golden-tiled iwan with turquoise/blue tilework below, courtyard walls; gold glowing in the sunset against blue-grey sky.
Large three-storey facade of tall symmetrical recessed arches in rows (3 levels, ~25 niches), with two minarets on top flanking the facade; sand-coloured adobe/brick, a square plaza in front.

Huge adobe mud-brick citadel on a rise: crenellated walls with many square watchtowers, a tall central citadel (governor's quarter) at the peak, stepped honeycomb of ruined dwellings below; uniform ochre-sand colour.
Tall 72m red-brick tower: a ten-sided fluted body with ten triangular buttresses, a conical brick roof on top, on a mound; two Kufic bands near top (no text drawn). Very slender vertical silhouette.

Massive turquoise-blue double-shell dome (~50m) on an octagonal drum, with 8 slender minarets at the corners (8 minarets); brick body with tall arched portals and arcaded gallery at the dome's base, turquoise tile accents, plain surrounding.
Modern tomb: a tall tower of 12 pillars with a conical roof on a square base (inspired by Gonbad-e Qabus-style tower), set on a platform surrounded by columns, with a garden.

landmark_en: Taq-e Bostan with its reflecting pool
visual_description: Two large arched iwans carved into a rock cliff face (large and small), semicircular tops, relief figures within, a spring pool below the cliff reflecting the arches; trees alongside.

Sassanid-era brick/stone castle on a hilltop in Khorramabad: a large rectangular mass with 12 round towers/ramparts, walls with crenellated ends, a stone/brick body, squat towers; sits on the hill above the city.

Cliff-side Sasanian/Safavid hydraulic works: arched brick bridge-dam (Gargar) with a row of mill houses with arched openings, and artificial waterfalls dropping from the canal into a pool; ochre brick and stone.

Sufi shrine ensemble: a main tomb with a blue-tiled conical dome/tower with a fluted cylinder, adjacent arched porch/iwans in brick, lower domed halls, and a courtyard with a gate; blue and turquoise tile accents on brick.

Armenian monastery (St. Thaddeus), black-and-white striped stone church: a rectangular basilica with a polygonal drum and conical roof over the center, a front arched porch, striped black/white stone courses, nestled in a green valley.

Two-storey stone/adobe houses with ochre-brown walls and wooden latticed windows stacked in steep terraces up a mountain slope; each flat roof is the yard of the house above; narrow stairs; fog and green forest above.

Huge symmetrical cone-shaped volcano, snow-capped summit with a slightly flattened crater tip, grey-blue rocky flanks fading down to green foothills; dominant central cone ~60% of width, no buildings required.

Large square-plan Qajar brick caravanserai: a tall central pointed gate portal, 4 iwans facing a courtyard, tiered arcaded rooms around the courtyard, a large dome behind the southern iwan with 4 semi-domes; courtyard count differs between sources.
Stone houses on both slopes of a steep valley, stepped so each roof is the yard of the house above; a river through the middle with narrow bridges; grey-ochre stone, wood and blue window accents.

Hilltop stone-and-gypsum Qajar-era governor's castle: a rectangular walled compound with corner round towers and a central mass, flat roofs, set on a hill above Ilam city and surrounded by oak forest.
Square/rectangular stone fort with round bastion towers on the corners, thick walls and crenellations, on a low promontory by the sea; red-ochre island rock around.

landmark_fa: محله قدیمی بوشهر کنار خلیج فارس
landmark_en: Old quarter of Bushehr by the Persian Gulf
visual_description: Row of 2-3 storey flat-roofed cream/ochre coastal houses with wooden balconies, shutters and small arches, a tall minaret/lighthouse at one side, wooden boats moored in the water in front.

landmark_en: Chabahar Bay with traditional lenj boats
visual_description: Curved calm bay with sandy shore and brown barren hills behind, several traditional wooden lenj dhows with tall curved prows, single mast and furled lateen sail, in the foreground, reflected in the water.
Qajar-era garden in Birjand: a central two-storey pavilion with columned porch and symmetrical facade, long axial water pool and channels, tall surrounding walls, trees; sand-coloured.

Qajar-era brick mansion in Bojnord, symmetrical, two floors with a porch on each floor on north and south sides, columned porches with brick and turquoise/yellow tile accents, ~34 rooms, two large halls.

Qajar city gate: brick facade with a tall central pointed arch (pishtaq) framed in a rectangular panel, tile murals on the northern face, a row of small blue-tiled baby minarets on top, flanking towers; brick-ochre with blue tile accents.
Large shrine with a golden dome and gold-topped minarets, an iwan with turquoise/blue tilework at the entrance, courtyard walls, golden roof glints; blue and gold palette.

landmark_fa: مسجد سپهداری و بازار قدیم اراک
landmark_en: Sepahdar Mosque and the old Bazaar of Arak
visual_description: Qajar brick mosque with a ~12m entrance iwan (large pointed arch) and a plain single-shell brick dome (~18m) on a square chamber, next to the vaulted brick bazaar with shallow domes/skylights.

landmark_en: Kuhrang waterfall in the Zagros mountains
visual_description: Mountain waterfall (likely Sheikh Ali Khan) dropping over a low rocky ledge in a green high-altitude valley then running as a stream, with snow-topped Zardkuh heights behind.
Waterfall dropping over a rocky cliff in a forested ravine, a main wide fall with a pool below, surrounded by oak trees and rock walls.
Natural scenery: a calm dam lake in a mountain valley, a curved concrete dam wall at one end, steep brown/grey Alborz slopes with snow and patchy greenery reflecting in the water.
